verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents autoscaling GPU Node Pools in its managed Kubernetes service via the Cluster Autoscaler, and a Managed Inference offering with model deployments and capacity claims. However, the developer still manages Kubernetes clusters and node pools rather than deploying code to serverless workers, and nothing documents scale-to-zero or per-request serverless billing. missing for 10: a serverless GPU worker/endpoint product, documented scale-to-zero behavior, a code-to-endpoint deploy workflow without cluster management, independent or hands-on corroboration.
